propositions: Rebar must safely integrate eight external providers across nine deployment environments without weakening SDK-native refresh, workload identity, or credential rotation
Deployment resolves external secret stores before process startup; Rebar consumes provider-native authentication and narrowly scoped static secret carriers at adapter boundaries only
Operation-certificate signing accepts exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or multiline REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY; no application-owned SSM retrieval or universal secret broker is introduced
Static credentials rotate by restart/redeploy; no automatic hot-reload, file-watcher, or ambient environment mutation is added
Rebar-known credentials are removed from unrelated sibling subprocess environments while preserving native Git/SSH/AWS/proxy/CA chains for trusted same-capability children
